items.title: The construction of the composition of relative cycles is compatible with base change
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file relative-cycles.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: 4 行陈述（25 行证明）、合成构造的基变换相容：先引理化断言，再纤维逐点展开，拉回链两步等式把 alpha' 的拉回落到纤维 alpha_s，beta'_{s'} 即 beta_s 基变换，末步具名引理收。1 处引用具名，无 omit，干净收。

primary.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-construction-base-change (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 2808-2811

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: Unpack the assertion: for g : S' -> S the base-changed composition alpha' circ beta' should equal the base change of alpha circ beta; compute fibrewise at s' over s, where the fibre of the composition is the intersection of the pullback of alpha' to the fibre of Y' with the fibre of beta'; rewrite the pullback of alpha' as the pullback of the fibre alpha_s to the fibre of Y' via the chain of base-change compatibilities, observe beta'_{s'} is the base change of beta_s by s' -> s, and conclude by applying the base-change lemma for the composition action to the fibre data (source lines 2813-2837)
